name: Korean-Style Wings with Mixed Veggie, Blue Cheese & Sesame Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 245°C (475°F). Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 orange bell peppers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and divide between the baking sheets. Sprinkle with baking powder and salt; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed
1 tbsp baking powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with sesame seeds, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, honey, vinegar, and pepper. Whisk to combine the wing sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp sesame seeds
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
3 tbsp honey
2 tbsp rice vinegar
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, mayo, additional vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumbers into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Add broccoli slaw, blue cheese, and additional sesame seeds to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; toss to combine the slaw and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (340 g) pkgs broccoli slaw
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese
2 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are done, drizzle with sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and slaw between plates; drizzle any remaining sauce over wings and enjoy!
